verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no data-export or offboarding feature: no bulk export of invoices, subscriptions or usage records, and no way to port stored card or payment-method data to another provider. Saving individual invoices as PDF and a general-purpose API that mirrors web-client operations are only adjacent building blocks, not a documented portability capability. Storing customer cards for recurring charges is documented, but nothing shows those cards can be moved out.

support.subject: As a finance lead, I can export every subscription, invoice, and usage record — and port stored payment methods out to another provider — if I choose to leave
